entries.translated: Changed `/cost`, `$.session.usage()`, `--max-budget-usd` and the cost and token metrics to count a mod's `$.model.complete` and `$.model.classify` calls

entries.original: Changed the programs that Claude Code's sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, to run without Claude Code's sign-in tokens and API keys in their environment
entries.translated: Changed the programs that Claude Code's sandbox starts for its own use, such as its network bridge, to run without Claude Code's sign-in tokens and API keys in their environment

entries.original: Changed ripgrep, local git commands and the sandbox runtime's own helper programs to run without the mTLS client key's passphrase in their environment
entries.translated: Changed ripgrep, local git commands and the sandbox runtime's own helper programs to run without the mTLS client key's passphrase in their environment

entries.original: Remote Control: Changed `/resume` and `/teleport` to disconnect first when the connected session has a share link, or when that can't be checked; run `/remote-control` to connect again
entries.translated: Remote Control: Changed `/resume` and `/teleport` to disconnect first when the connected session has a share link, or when that can't be checked; run `/remote-control` to connect again

entries.original: Changed Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks and Cowork cloud sessions to start despite `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`: the hosted container has no command sandbox
entries.translated: Changed Claude Code on the web, cloud scheduled tasks and Cowork cloud sessions to start despite `sandbox.failIfUnavailable`: the hosted container has no command sandbox

entries.original: Changed requests for settings, permission rules, hooks or status over a cloud or self-hosted session's connection to return less or be refused; what applies in the session is unchanged
entries.translated: Changed requests for settings, permission rules, hooks or status over a cloud or self-hosted session's connection to return less or be refused; what applies in the session is unchanged

entries.original: Changed `claude -p` with no cached account data to wait for that data before its first request, so a first run in a clean environment can start a few seconds later
entries.translated: Changed `claude -p` with no cached account data to wait for that data before its first request, so a first run in a clean environment can start a few seconds later

entries.original: Changed Claude's instructions to keep files you'll want out of its temporary scratchpad folder, which can be cleared
entries.translated: Changed Claude's instructions to keep files you'll want out of its temporary scratchpad folder, which can be cleared

entries.original: Changed marketplace `ref` to accept the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag; clients before this version can't clone such a pin, so a marketplace pinned this way stops loading there
entries.translated: Changed marketplace `ref` to accept the full ID of any commit on a branch or tag; clients before this version can't clone such a pin, so a marketplace pinned this way stops loading there

entries.original: Changed plugin marketplace and plugin downloads to use a CONNECT tunnel when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set; a proxy that refuses CONNECT now fails them
entries.translated: Changed plugin marketplace and plugin downloads to use a CONNECT tunnel when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set; a proxy that refuses CONNECT now fails them

entries.original: Changed `-p` and SDK runs in a worktree or submodule mounted into a container to apply `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules only once the folder is trusted
entries.translated: Changed `-p` and SDK runs in a worktree or submodule mounted into a container to apply `.claude/settings.local.json` allow rules only once the folder is trusted

entries.original: Changed self-hosted runners to refuse a session whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, other than a `checkout` hook's checkout
entries.translated: Changed self-hosted runners to refuse a session whose session folder or repository path is a symbolic link, other than a `checkout` hook's checkout

entries.original: Removed "ask your admin to raise it" from spend limit and shared budget errors in cloud sessions and under Remote Control
